title: CreatePurchaseRequestPayload
description: Payload for the CREATE_PURCHASE_REQUEST intent. Initiates a procurement workflow that triggers budget check and approval routing.

request_id.description: Unique procurement request identifier (e.g. 'pr-2026-001'). Duplicates are rejected.

vendor.description: Vendor or supplier name. New vendors require VENDOR_RISK_REVIEW before first payment.

vendor_id.description: Optional reference to an existing vendor record.

business_purpose.description: Why this spend is needed. Vague purposes ('miscellaneous', 'supplies') trigger AUDIT_REVIEW_REQUEST.

business_id.description: Business unit / cost center the spend will post against.

budget_bucket.description: Named budget allocation (e.g. 'capex_q2', 'opex_marketing'). If absent, Finance must approve as off-budget.

needed_by.description: Optional deadline by which the goods/services are needed.

alternatives_considered.description: Other vendors evaluated. Required for spends over $1,000 to demonstrate value evaluation.

attachments.description: References to supporting documents (quotes, specs, comparison sheets).

is_recurring.description: True for subscriptions or recurring service contracts; downstream may apply different controls.

allOf.description: Spends over $1,000 require alternatives_considered to demonstrate value evaluation.

examples.business_purpose: Hardware for office expansion to support headcount growth
